newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sept CPI rises 0.3 pct mo/mo (0.2 pct Aug).
newsitem.headline: Czech Sept CPI rises 0.3 pct mo/mo (0.2 pct Aug).

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.3 percent in September, putting prices 8.9 percent higher than in the same month of last year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Tuesday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION Sept 96 Aug 96 Sept 95
SEPT CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. August basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 20.3 percent from the average level for 1994 while September's sliding average using a 1993 base was 8.7 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995. The CSU said the 3.6 percent rise in the education sector was due to an increase in fees at the beginning of the 1996-97 school year at language and art schools by 12.4 percent, at university and high school residences by 7.7 percent, and at schoool cafeterias by 5.7 percent.
